episodes.name: Dawn of Heroes
episodes.overviewEn: The Tower of Fate crashes into Gotham City and as the city descends into chaos, a new group of heroes emerge, hoping to restore order.

episodes.name: Friend of Foe (1)
episodes.overviewEn: An old friend helps the heroes learn more about the Tower of Fate's secrets.

episodes.name: Friend or Foe (2)
episodes.overviewEn: A new friend joins the fight to stop evil from securing the power of Fate.

episodes.name: Fear, Revealed (1)
episodes.overviewEn: As the power of darkness grows stronger, our heroes search for an artifact that may change their Fates. Lois and Clark face a pivotal moment.

episodes.name: Fear, Revealed (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Circe makes Barbara Minerva an enticing offer as the heroes scramble to enact a plan to rescue her.

episodes.name: Broken Fate (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Wonder Woman struggles to cope with a deep betrayal. Doctor Fate entrusts the heroes with a crucial mission.

episodes.name: Broken Fate (2)
episodes.overviewEn: The heroes pursue a weapon strong enough to destroy Circe. A terrible death promises dire consequences.
